text:
mike: Heads up — Sparrowhawk POC demo: small prompts TTFT ~1.1s and then hitting 429s after a few minutes. Can eng/ops swarm? :grimacing:
sasha: Hosted sandbox or dedicated? Theyll ask about pricing if we recommend dedicated lanes.
mike: Hosted sandbox, us-west. Demo script bursts ~10rps. They had prefill=true.
oliver: Quick triage: prefill + default batch window can inflate TTFT on tiny prompts. Also bursts can fill queues and trigger tenant throttles.
ops-bot: Snapshot taken: pool=us-west-sandbox, avg_ttft=1.12s, p95=1.3s, queue_depth=45, kv_hit=14%, top_error=429_capacity_exceeded.
oliver: Try: 1) set prefill=false for demo A/B, 2) reduce batch_window_ms to 8, 3) ops temporarily bump tenant rps.
mike: Did A/B: prefill=false + batch_window=8 => avg_ttft ~0.45s p95 ~0.6s, no 429s in first 90s.
sasha: Good. I'll draft pricing for a small reserved lane and mention burst credits. Ops, file a ticket to raise rps during evaluations.
ops-bot: OPS-4892 created: temp tenant rps uplift + monitor.
mike: Thanks team, sending recap to customer now. Closing unless it resurfaces. :thumbsup:
